text: The Sword Hunter Badge item description states that Ludwig was the first of many Healing Church hunters, many of whom were clerics, to transform into hideous beasts.
Lawrence, founder of the Healing Church, became the first cleric beast and is fought separately in the Old Hunters DLC.

The Healing Church sealed and deliberately burned the entire district of Old Yharnam, killing both transformed and untransformed residents, officially to contain the scourge of beasts; its burnt remains can still be explored.
The burning of Old Yharnam did not stop the plague, which continued spreading through Yharnam via the Church's ongoing blood ministration in other districts.
Queen Yharnam appears in a blood vision after Rom's death, shown in ceremonial robes or a blood-soaked dress with hands crossed over the child she carried, facing a descending moon.

Queen Yharnam entered a contract with Oedon, a formless great one with no physical body, and bore his child, Mergo, an infant Great One; the birth effectively ended her existence, leaving her as a suspended remnant rather than fully dead.
The player arrives in Yahar'gul after being abducted from the streets of Yharnam by bell-ringing women serving the School of Mensis.
The bodies composing the One Reborn are residents of Yharnam who received blood ministration from the Healing Church and were later abducted by Mensis operatives.
Rom was once a scholar of Byrgenwerth before being transformed by contact with a Great One.
Rom was placed in the hidden lake by Master Willem to maintain a veil hiding the blood moon's descent and the secret of Queen Yharnam.
The Choir's orphanage actually supplied children as experimental subjects for research into guided ascension, since children's minds were considered more malleable.
Most children used in the Choir's ascension experiments died or went mad; those who 'succeeded' became Celestial Emissaries with no memories or identity.
Ebrietas was discovered by Byrgenwerth scholars in the ancient Thumerian Labyrinths beneath Yharnam.
Ebrietas shared her cosmic blood, a purer strain unlike ordinary old blood that does not cause beasthood, with the Healing Church scholars for their most advanced research.
Ebrietas remained alone in the Altar of Despair for years between scholarly visits, long after the Choir's experiments ended.
Cainhurst Castle predates the Healing Church, having been the seat of an aristocratic family practicing their own blood arts called the Vile Bloods.
A traitor from Byrgenwerth brought forbidden knowledge to Cainhurst, allowing the Vile Bloods to develop their blood arts.
The Healing Church branded the Vile Bloods as corruptors of sacred blood ministration and sent Logarius to eliminate them at Cainhurst.
Unable to kill the immortal Queen Annalise, Logarius sealed her in the castle's throne room and guarded the seal himself for the remainder of his life.
Ludwig founded the Healing Church Hunters as a formal organization, succeeding Gehrman's original small workshop, establishing ranks and a theological framework for the hunt.
Ludwig eventually succumbed to the old blood and transformed into a beast, merging in equine form possibly with the horse he once rode.
Maria was present at the fishing hamlet when scholars arrived and participated in or failed to prevent the killing of villagers and the desecration of Kos.
Lawrence founded the Healing Church after leaving Byrgenwerth with the old blood, against Master Willem's warnings of overreach.
Lawrence burns in the nightmare because he ordered the burning of Old Yharnam, incinerating a district and its inhabitants.
Byrgenwerth scholars uncovered the buried Pthumerian knowledge about the old blood and great ones and ignored its implications.
Blood Ministration, the church's core healing practice, is depicted as having genuinely and effectively treated ordinary illness before its darker consequences emerged.
Several hunters throughout Yharnam's history, including Ludwig and Gehrman, eventually succumbed to the very forces they fought against, establishing a recurring pattern of hunting's risks.
The deepest layers of the chalice dungeon system connect narratively to an ancient civilization predating Yharnam's recorded history, which pursued its own relationship with the Great Ones.
Pthumeru, the primary civilization associated with the Chalice Dungeon system, developed sophisticated blood-related rituals and technologies distinct from but related to Byrgenwerth's traditions.
The Old Hunters expansion's narrative timeline and story are framed as occurring in the past relative to the base game's main story.
Story revelations in The Old Hunters expansion, especially those about Laurence's uncertain final fate, recontextualize events and locations from the base game.
Real historical fears about contagion and quarantine, including isolating sick community members, echo in Bloodborne's depiction of Old Yharnam's burning and the panic over the beast plague.
Bloodborne's opening sequence has the hunter awaken in Iosefka's Clinic before receiving their first transfusion of old blood.
Community timeline reconstructions attempt to place events like Ludwig's founding of organized hunting and the Choir's escalating cosmic ambitions into coherent chronological sequence.
